::: {.tagline}
ML Engineer & NLP Researcher · African Language Technologies · Responsible AI
:::

I build ML systems and conduct research on **natural language processing for low-resource African languages**. My work addresses the gap in AI tools for African language speakers — through machine translation, named entity recognition, gender bias detection, and explainable AI.

My research appears in venues including TACL and AMTA. I have contributed to large-scale African NLP benchmarks such as [MasakhaNER](https://direct.mit.edu/tacl/article-abstract/doi/10.1162/tacl_a_00416/107614) and multilingual translation datasets. I am actively seeking a **PhD position** to advance research at the intersection of low-resource NLP, responsible AI, and computational linguistics for African languages.

## Research Interests

::: {.interests-list}
- Low-resource & African language NLP
- Machine translation & gender bias in MT
- Explainable & interpretable AI for low-resource settings
- Named entity recognition
- Large language models for under-resourced languages
- Information retrieval & computational linguistics
:::
